subject: general
question: Partition of Bengal held in ______.
solution:
The Correct answer is __1905__​. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Partition of ​Bengal took place in 1905.
 
• Lord Curzon was the one who divided it.
 
• On October 16, 1905, the division of Bengal took effect.
 
• The British used the partition of Bengal to carry out their divide and rule agenda in India.
 
• One of the most prominent anti-partition movements was the Swadeshi movement.
 
• In 1911, the Bengal Partition was abolished. Lord Hardinge II canceled it
 
• Bengal was divided for the second time in 1947 as part of India's split.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Anti partition Movement:

 
• Opposing the decision of dividing the state, people came out on the streets of Bengal in protest.
 
• People showcased the Hindu-Muslim unity in various processions.
 
• The day of partition was observed as 'National Day of Mourning'.
 
• People came out on streets singing 'Bande Mataram' and 'Amar Sonar Bangla'.
 
• On the day of Raksha Bandhan Hindus and the Muslims tied rakhis on the wrists of each other as a symbol of Brotherhood.
